propositions: GitHub Actions pytest matrix jobs hang at 99% progress for 1.7–4.3 hours until manually cancelled, blocking hosted runner capacity and later queued runs.

Affected Gerrit patchsets 1129/1130/1131/1136 omit commit 96a0d5c3f, causing per-blob lazy-fetch during git checkout-index on blobless clones; contemporaneous fixed-ancestry runs complete successfully in 6–18 minutes.

Job-level timeout-minutes is absent from .github/workflows/_build-and-test.yml test job, allowing GitHub's 360-minute default; normal execution is 10–16 minutes, and six-hour hangs require manual intervention.

Gerrit change 1129 contains a regression in FakeJiraClient.search_issues that ignores startAt/maxResults pagination parameters, causing test_comment_map_matches_the_shared_contract to loop infinitely and timeout on affected patchsets.
Manual cancellation of stuck runs clears the queue and occupies hosted workers; a 60-minute timeout bound prevents indefinite retention and eliminates manual-clear dependence.

No repository-level timeout documents the job execution bound; caller sweep (.github/workflows/test.yml and gerrit-verify.yaml) confirms both consume the test job result and benefit from a bounded failure.
